name: Ootaki Kyuuta
source:
Cody Hackins is a "fanboy" of The Steel Samurai: Warrior of Neo Olde Tokyo and idolizes its main character, the Steel Samurai, played by Will Powers. He frequently sneaks into Global Studios to see his masked hero, much to the annoyance of the security guard, Wendy Oldbag, though he never saw Powers' face until the days of the Pink Princess.

Hackins appears to be very intelligent for his age. He is able to use the internet well and is very good at forcing people into bargains and winning them. He is also very short-tempered, rude and unfriendly to most people. Hackins is obsessed with the Steel Samurai, almost to the point of delirium. He is known for sneaking into the studios, taping every show, and going to every live performance to take pictures for his "Path to Glory" scrapbook. Hackins' father also takes him to the Steel Samurai amusement park every year.

[Based on his [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
